description: Defines the class rlc_tx_tm_entity, a transmission entity for RLC in transparent mode, including its members, methods, and interactions with buffer state and timers.

classes.name: rlc_tx_tm_entity
classes.description: A class representing a transparent mode RLC transmission entity handling SDUs, buffer states, and timers.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all timers and marks the entity as stopped.

methods.name: handle_sdu
methods.description: Handles incoming SDUs, possibly for retransmission.

methods.name: discard_sdu
methods.description: Discards an SDU identified by its sequence number.

methods.name: pull_pdu
methods.description: Retrieves a PDU from the entity.

methods.name: handle_changed_buffer_state
methods.description: Defers notification of buffer state changes to the executor.

methods.name: update_mac_buffer_state
methods.description: Immediately updates the MAC layer with the current buffer state.
